We employ augmented language to unified sequence labeling tasks. Example transformations for Named Entity Recognition (NER), Relation Extraction, Joint Entity Relation extraction, Dialogue State Tracking (DST), and Semantic Role Labeling (SRL).
outputs: augmented natural language sequences representing structured labels

The model generates structured outputs in a sequence-to-sequence format using special tokens (e.g., [|, ], |, =) to represent entities, relations, dialogue states, or semantic roles, which are then parsed into clean predictions.
